correctness.rationale: Full finite chains are exhaustively enumerated from a combinatorial construction of the graph. Verified exact integer matrices satisfy B3 B4=0; rank(B3), rank(B4) are (8,28) for incident endpoints and (14,27) for nonincident endpoints. All nonzero integer Smith factors of B4 are 1, hence image primitive and homology torsion-free. S6-transitivity (checked by all 720 underlying permutations), reversal and bipartite parity cover all 450 ordered opposite-side endpoint pairs. Rank sum 360*4=1440. Embedded exact checker replay required; no finite experiments are extrapolated to a larger graph family.

value.rationale: The unique cubic girth-eight cage is the canonical sharp-boundary case for second-off-diagonal magnitude homology. Integral torsion is the unresolved mathematical invariant despite known characteristic-two dimensions. Proving exact integral freeness at every prime provides a natural complete group classification in its first surviving off-diagonal degree and useful reference for generalized-quadrangle comparisons; it is not asserted as a universal theorem.
